entries.author: The build desk
entries.text:
A swarm is only as good as the people building it.

Identity-MD puts contribution at the center: show up, make something useful, and let the work speak. That’s the part of $IMD worth paying attention to.

This is an illustrative post, written for the Signal preview. It demonstrates how a longer community update can stay readable without leaving the feed. Visit the project’s own documentation for verified details.

entries.title: Identity-MD, explained: a starting point for the curious
entries.text:

Start with the official documentation, explore the contributor network, and follow the original sources. A community-owned project is easier to understand when you can see the work in progress.

entries.author: An open notebook
entries.text:
The most interesting part of Identity-MD isn’t a chart. It’s a network of people making things in the open.

Better tools, more context, fewer barriers to contributing. A small piece of useful work adds up when a whole community is doing it.

entries.text:

entries.author: Swarm perspectives
entries.text:
A small wish for every crypto feed: more original ideas, fewer copies of the same post.

Identity-MD deserves a place where the whole conversation is easy to follow, from a detailed technical article to the community’s best meme.
